subject.title: [Feature]: Visible agent-to-agent messaging for ACP thread-bound sessions (proxy-only delivery without main session creation)

question: Which visible ACP-thread delivery contract should OpenClaw support for coordinator-to-worker instructions without creating main Discord session metadata?
rationale: The code can support more than one narrow fix shape, but choosing between a sessions_send API extension, a message proxy-only path, or an ACP-bound-thread exclusion rule changes public API semantics, upgrade behavior, and security boundaries.

options.title: Define Narrow Visible ACP Send
options.body: Add an explicit sessions_send-style visible delivery mode scoped to authorized ACP-bound sessions and prove it does not create unintended main-session metadata.

options.title: Define Proxy-Only Message Send
options.body: Add a message/gateway send bypass for authorized proxy delivery while preserving normal outbound mirroring for every other send path.

options.title: Decline Core API For Now
options.body: Keep the relay pattern plugin-owned or ClawHub-owned, accepting that the current core surfaces cannot fully avoid the reported session-stub side effect.

recommendation.title: Define Narrow Visible ACP Send
recommendation.body: Add an explicit sessions_send-style visible delivery mode scoped to authorized ACP-bound sessions and prove it does not create unintended main-session metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a public API and routing-boundary decision spanning sessions_send, gateway protocol, Discord delivery, and outbound metadata, where steipete has the strongest history signal.
